verdict.rationale: Stripe documents both an embedded Checkout option, where the payment page is "embedded on your site" rather than a redirect, and Elements for building "a fully customized payment page." Its low-risk integrations also send payment details directly to Stripe, off the merchant's servers. Together these cover the core of embedding customizable payment components in your own site. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of customization depth (styling/appearance controls, component types, mobile/in-app embedding), independent or hands-on corroboration.
